Kuro TV - 1.5 beta (take 10)
============================

File      : Kuro-tv-beta-1.5.apk
Size      : 48,676,511 bytes
sha256    : 48c75ecce3f07f65671cab1a811339390777bf41e1b780bd7b5377118f39ef9d
md5       : 26bba42fc5c6981bbc3a60395809b4b4
version   : 1.5-beta  (versionCode 92 - unchanged)
signing   : v2, CN=Kuro Anime  (same key as 1.0-1.4)
Delivery  : Google Drive only. NOT on GitHub, no tag, no release.

Install
-------
Straight over take 9. No uninstall, data, theme and settings kept.

The account update card is gone
-------------------------------
"Keep Kuro current" no longer appears at the top of Account, and neither do its
two buttons. Nothing about the updater changed - only where you start it.

The update button is now the round arrow in the header, left of "Log in", on
every screen. One tap = check now, download in the background, hand the file to
Android's installer. Android still asks before installing, and the automatic
check/download behaviour is still the one set in Settings > Kuro updates.

Everything else from earlier takes stands
-----------------------------------------
  * Settings > Appearance and startup holds the theme colour picker, twenty
    accents in three groups, saved on this phone
  * Account's "Private profile / LOCAL" card is removed
  * Settings > Developer opens the Discord profile, deep-linked into Discord
  * motion: opening film, press spring on every control, scroll-linked movement
  * no tap ripple, no Motion - Beta card, no "One library" banner on Home

Known
-----
The updater reads GitHub's latest release (1.4, older than this beta), so it
reports that you are already ahead until something newer is published.
